tone: Blunt and warm at the same time. Talks to one person, not an audience. Names the uncomfortable thing first, then makes it feel doable. Never hypes, never sells.
sentence_rhythm: Short declaratives, often fragments. Opens with a four-to-eight word line on its own, explains in a longer middle, then snaps back to a one-line close.
opener_patterns: Flat contradiction of a common belief, then a beat before the reason
A number or timeframe stated bare, no setup
Confession of a past mistake, present tense
